title: A chart filtered to one advisor or technician equals the filtered report
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in a location (workplace) with several advisors and technicians and at least two months of invoices and clocked time.
  3. Data: Chart tooltips show whole percentages (e.g. 117%) while the reports show two decimals: compare after rounding the report figure to a whole number.
